title: 36 Hours in South Beach, Fla.
abstract: Like other American magnets of decadence, this city still has an irresistible, democratic pull. From the Iowa retiree to the Bentley-driving rapper, it remains the place to strut shamelessly.

title: 36 Hours in South Beach
abstract: From Tommy Tune and surfers in South Pointe Park to the velvet ropes at the latest nightclubs, South Beach offers a cocktail of both the new and the classic.

title: 36 Hours in Stowe, Vt.
abstract: The grande dame of Green Mountain ski resort towns just got a $400 million upgrade, but underneath all the glitz, it still feels like a quaint New England town.

title: 36 Hours in Kuala Lumpur
abstract: With its looming skyscrapers, stellar cuisine and thumping night life, the Malaysian capital has emerged as one of Southeast Asia’s most alluring metropolises.

title: 36 Hours in San Miguel de Allende, Mexico
abstract: With its breezy blue skies and baroque architecture, this colonial town has been a tropical haven for expatriates since the 1930s.

title: 36 Hours in Tucson, Ariz.
abstract: A revitalized downtown and a deep-rooted Hispanic community have given the city a youthful and multicultural glow.
